Name: ThreefoldReach
Signature: The Unanswered Interval: bell without a last note
Landscape: Roads stitched through contradictory maps, refugee lanterns and a split-record archive.
MainQuestion: Can an unrecorded refuge and an officially documented truth both be real?
Mechanism: Place evidence against the bell sound in Bellwold; compare the absence in Paperhaven without fabricating either account.
Danger: Moving routes and civic access; neither path is a combat-only choke.
CareOutcome: Preserve public shelter access and lantern use.
TruthOutcome: Make the missing record inspectable without forcefully identifying every protected resident.
Ability: Witnesscraft identifies firsthand testimony; Living Roads opens earned community paths.
Foreshadow: Bell silence is later heard in rain, fire and choir; never say Nhal-Vey here.
ReturnChapter: A stranger can trace both shelter and archive routes, meeting residents who remember the chosen side.
HeldMorning: The road gains a visible scar through existing public landmarks.
ManyMornings: The same street has two navigable, clearly signposted interpretations.
ManualTest: Choose both paths on separate saves; reload preserves route and individual witness memories.

Name: WidowedRain
Signature: Missing water as an economic and environmental absence
Landscape: Dry docks under persistent rain, wet ledgers, hollow ship-roof shelters.
MainQuestion: Who owns the proof of a sea that no longer exists?
Mechanism: Weather counter, rain sluice and hand-operated storm break; unique audio pulse warns before damage.
Danger: Rain-lane pulses, with legible blue warning and a reliable dry shelter.
CareOutcome: Shelter ferry users without requiring old ownership papers.
TruthOutcome: Preserve the ledger and collateral history without declaring private survivors debtors.
Enemy: Rainward tide hazard; local story guardian remains optional
Ability: Cartography distinguishes mapped and personally verified crossing; Tomorrow Debt offers risky short-term action.
Foreshadow: A missing tide is dated like a loan due before birth.
ReturnChapter: Storm records update to acknowledge actual Rainward public choice; no generic all-knowing NPC reaction.
HeldMorning: The missing coast retains the last honest tide mark.
ManyMornings: Two differently timed shoreline marks remain readable together.
ManualTest: A player can walk the storm safe line, save/reload and still inspect both evidence perspectives.

Name: HearthBeneath
Signature: An impossible sun's heat and shared physical obligations
Landscape: Inward mountain city with public kilns, soot families and thermal canal controls.
MainQuestion: Who pays to keep an unowned flame alive?
Mechanism: Two-channel furnace valve and heat-shutter pair; show actual pipe change and temperature field.
Danger: Timed heat pulses with stable visual rim and cooled recovery window.
CareOutcome: Keep unregistered homes warm without demanding signatures.
TruthOutcome: Expose the true provenance of fuel and require a public repair plan.
Enemy: Kiln-hazard encounter, not an arbitrary fire monster
Ability: Oathbinding ties explicit promises to a measurable heat benefit; Legacy Forging records a genuine deed.
Foreshadow: Flames lack exactly the same note missing from the Reach's bell.
ReturnChapter: Citizens relight hearths based on the route player actually maintained.
HeldMorning: Two shadows belong to one common flame.
ManyMornings: Twin embers suggest coexisting origins without doubling resources.
ManualTest: Valve visibly directs heat, hazard has readable counterplay, old community decision survives.

Name: TidalLedger
Signature: Contracts dated before their signers' birth
Landscape: Tide clocks in stranded boats, ferry passages and flooded civic ledgers.
MainQuestion: Who can pledge a tomorrow for someone not yet born?
Danger: Ledger tide lanes with visible warning and cover; don't demand repeated debt farming.
CareOutcome: Make a child-safe ferry that never charges future passengers.
TruthOutcome: Publish verifiable fraud without forcibly identifying protected borrowers.
Enemy: Collector of Unborn Days, optional witnessed guardian
Ability: Tomorrow Debt + Oathbinding opens calendar observatory only after completed Echo.
Foreshadow: The ledger implies the world has been taking loans against nonexistent histories.
ReturnChapter: Local residents remember ferry or archive outcomes, guardian mercy or defeat, and observatory archive.
HeldMorning: The estuary's promises are carved into visible stable dates.
ManyMornings: Two future and past receipts are presented side by side, not merged into one.
ManualTest: First-quest two routes, aftermath, Echo, optional guardian, optional dual-rite door independently survive reload.

Name: SkyBelow
Signature: Songs physically holding inverted architecture aloft
Landscape: Hanging neighborhoods and two load-bearing musical support scores.
MainQuestion: Can you give silenced people a voice without dropping the homes they support?
Danger: Inverted gravity stress pulse with anchored safe walkway, horizon remains stable in accessibility mode.
CareOutcome: Stabilize homes through a voluntary shared support rhythm.
TruthOutcome: Recover forbidden singers' names without forcing their return to compulsory work.
Enemy: Missing Chorister, optional guardian with audible pre-strike cadence
Ability: Unwrite Law + Paradox Convergence opens paired supporting-harmony observatory.
Foreshadow: The exact missing musical rest is identical to the Unanswered Interval.
ReturnChapter: A household's safety and a dissenting score remain independently inspectable.
HeldMorning: All public music includes the erased staff line.
ManyMornings: Two supporting harmonies can be seen without doubling the actual load.
ManualTest: Play both notes without instant collision, examine witnesses and verify chosen physical route remains.

Name: CinderSpine
Signature: Erased families compressed into history-bearing stone
Landscape: Quarry seams, ancestor mortar, rail braces and fossil family portraits.
MainQuestion: Can the city keep its homes without treating an ancestor as quarry material?
Danger: Pressure seam collapse with widening crack telegraph and a safe sidestep.
CareOutcome: Preserve accessible braced route and shelter without another erased generation.
TruthOutcome: Display a public family record of the quarry's origin with informed consent.
Ability: Legacy Forging + Understanding Bosses opens named-provenance observatory.
Foreshadow: The name sealed in mortar is not simply old: it belongs to an event removed from recorded chronology.
ReturnChapter: Repair homes using explicitly sourced materials while keeping the earlier choice visible.
HeldMorning: Stone names cut from history remain engraved and legible.
ManyMornings: Old and living genealogies appear on overlapping but separable walls.
ManualTest: Source and materials must remain causal; do not pretend a character can be restored by clicking a monument.

Name: HundredUnlived
Signature: People without official beginnings whose consent matters
Landscape: Doorways without census numbers, shelters behind name latches and voluntary public thresholds.
MainQuestion: Can someone exist without owing their identity to the city?
Danger: Name-scan lane warns before an identity pulse; silence and physical shielding can avoid it.
CareOutcome: Shelter stays reachable without public identity disclosure.
TruthOutcome: Public recognition is opt-in and revocable, not a forced population dump.
Ability: Witnesscraft + Borrowed Lives opens consent-bounded testimony observatory.
Foreshadow: Unregistered residents prove that absence and nonexistence are not the same.
ReturnChapter: A previously hidden resident chooses whether to speak; never auto-publish a name.
HeldMorning: Quiet houses remain visibly legitimate civic destinations.
ManyMornings: Private refuge and public threshold coexist with voluntary traversal.
ManualTest: No gameplay branch can reveal an individual's identity without its explicit recorded consent.

Name: OrchardOfKings
Signature: Unwritten laws growing from living roots
Landscape: Root courts, communal fruit stores, roads grafted from consent and a physically empty throne.
MainQuestion: How does a court keep enforcing a law nobody approved?
Danger: Roots point at the lane before a timed strike; alternate public path offers counterplay.
CareOutcome: Share the road and harvest without an inherited crown.
TruthOutcome: Expose the unratified court law while preserving living people's right to dissent.
Ability: Living Roads + Oathbinding opens public arboretum archives.
Foreshadow: The first legal rule was never signed; an answering mechanism continued enforcing it anyway.
ReturnChapter: Roots remember elected access and old disputes instead of being magically healed.
HeldMorning: Public harvest shares its path with a visibly empty crown.
ManyMornings: Two readable competing laws remain open to civil challenge.
ManualTest: Change root traversal collision after choice, preserve archive and access, never create an invisible monarch.

Name: FirstAbsence
Signature: Two truthful beginnings at one usable threshold
Landscape: Doorways without foundations, contradictory source maps, stable return line and northern final arena.
MainQuestion: Why did the world make a consciousness to eat unanswered questions?
Danger: Origin distortions, safe marked return; boss has four directional attacks with real windups.
CareOutcome: Reliable passage exists without erasing other origins.
TruthOutcome: Both maps remain inspectable without one mandatory universal history.
Enemy: Nhal-Vey, two required boss forms, then optional post-ending echo; Unfinished Witness optional guardian
Ability: Unwrite Law + Cartography opens optional safe-mapping observatory; not needed to finish.
Foreshadow: Reveal that Nhal-Vey suppresses questions; don't reveal false-victory twist during ordinary traversal.
ReturnChapter: Held Morning uses bell/names echo attacks; Many Mornings uses horizon/counterfactual echoes.
HeldMorning: Auvren's threshold keeps one visibly reliable exit after victory.
ManyMornings: Two contradictory dawns appear while a stable exit remains.
ManualTest: Main story reaches boss without sidequest grind; save preserves identity and all choices through both endings and optional rematch.
